title: HIV: Z21, B20 or R75
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's HIV status (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of AIDS.

HPI
The patient is a 36-year-old woman presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding her diagnosis of AIDS. She reports that she has been adherent to her prescribed antiretroviral therapy and feels well overall. She denies any new symptoms, fever, or acute illness. She notes that she has been maintaining a regular routine and feels her energy levels are stable. There are no new opportunistic infections reported today.

Medication List
- Antiretroviral therapy (ART) regimen
- Multivitamin supplement

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. She is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Skin and mucous membranes are clear. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs.

Assessment
AIDS. The patient is currently stable on her antiretroviral therapy. She shows no signs of new opportunistic infections at this time.

Plan
Continue current antiretroviral therapy. Follow up in three months for laboratory monitoring and clinical evaluation.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/14/2026
